title: Map 3: premium against matched share
description: Test 7's setup with the sector at 10% of spending, so that cheaper goods matter to everyone's real income. Incumbents earn a premium r in the sector and are its whole base-year workforce; a share h of them are matched, and the technology doubles matched output (g = 1). General workers can't use it. Outcome: the change in real income of unmatched incumbents, the type most likely to lose, and of matched incumbents. Where does it stay positive?
